subject: Lumina MAP — pricing & budget alignment
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@luminahealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>; Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>; Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Finance Ops <finance@luminahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Pricing & budget alignment for Lumina POC

Hi Vivek —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Lumina's evaluation team ran a quick internal sizing exercise and we landed on estimated monthly tokens and concurrent sessions for the POC. Finance asked for a concise licensing/credit ask and any standard MAP discounts you can offer for a 3-month commitment.

I've attached our current MAP worksheet (Lumina_MAP_v3.xlsx) with proposed timelines. Can you put together an updated pricing outline that shows:
- list price vs. proposed committed rate
- any one-time onboarding credits you can extend
- breakpoints for scaling (if we move from 50k -> 200k tokens/mo)

We need this by Wednesday EOD PT to circulate to procurement.

Thanks,
Ellen Park
Head of Platform Partnerships
Lumina Health

Attachments: Lumina_MAP_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Subject: Re: MAP: Pricing & budget alignment for Lumina POC

Thanks Ellen — appreciate the worksheet. We'll aim to get a clear pricing proposal back by Wednesday EOD PT. Internal plan: Neha, can you draft committed-rate tiers + any standard MAP credits? Karthik, please confirm the minimum commit sizes we can offer without escalations. Marissa, can you prepare a short one-pager that summarizes the MAP timeline for Lumina's procurement?

I'll draft the outward-facing proposal and include an approval path.

Best,
Vivek
VP, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>; Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Lumina pricing tiers + credit guidance

Vivek / team —

Quick notes after running numbers against Lumina_MAP_v3:
- Recommended committed tiers (monthly token units):
  * Bronze: 50k/mo -> list price (no discount)
  * Silver: 150k/mo -> 12% committed discount (standard MAP tier)
  * Gold: 300k/mo -> 20% committed discount (requires AM sign-off)
- One-time onboarding credit: up to $5k in credits for Silver; $12k for Gold (finance ok with credits as pre-burn only).
- Breakpoints: if they accelerate past 500k/mo within 90 days, we can prospectively apply an additional volume rebate (requires pricing committee).

Open questions:
- Do we want to offer a temporary trial credit (30-day) in addition to onboarding credit? Finance tends to gate those unless deal has high expansion signal.
- Need clarity from Karthik on whether the 3-month commit qualifies for Silver tier or if we need a 6-month minimum for discounts.

I'll prepare a short spreadsheet with these scenarios.

-Neha
Director, Revenue Operations
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>; Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: Lumina pricing tiers + credit guidance

Neha —

Short answers:
- For MAP discounts we treat a 3-month commit as eligible for Silver if the total committed tokens across the 3 months meet the Silver threshold (i.e., aggregated commit). So if Lumina signs a 3-month Silver-level commit we can apply the 12% discount across the committed volume.
- On credits: onboarding credits we can approve at up to $5k without exec approval; anything above $10k needs Sales Leader sign-off. The $12k figure will require me to get Marissa/leadership okay.
- For expedited approvals: I can route through Ben for finance pre-clear if we need to push beyond standard credit caps.

Action: I'll confirm an internal approval path and expected turnaround (24–48 hours) so we can meet Ellen's Wednesday EOD ask.

-Karthik
Head of Deals and Pricing
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Finance Ops <finance@luminahealth.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed MAP pricing & credits — Lumina (draft)

Ellen —

Attached is our draft proposal and a concise MAP timeline (see also the shared one-pager link). Summary highlights: 
- Silver: 150k tokens/mo (3-month aggregated commit) -> 12% discount; onboarding credit $5k (applied as up-front service credit).
- Gold: 300k tokens/mo -> 20% discount; onboarding credit $12k (requires Sales Leader sign-off).
- If Lumina exceeds 500k tokens/mo within the first 90 days, we'll evaluate a retrospective rebate or prospective rate adjustment (pricing committee approval).

Next steps we propose:
1) Lumina confirms target commit level and signatory (procurement contact) by Friday EOD PT.
2) Redwood issues final SOW and credit schedule once internal approvals are complete (Ben/Marissa looped for any >$10k credits).
3) Target go-live (POC start): July 5 — 3-month MAP window follows.

We attached a brief Excel with the tiered numbers (Lumina_Prices_v1.pdf) and the MAP one-pager at the link: https://docs.company/redwood/lumina-map-draft

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Vivek
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@luminahealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Finance Ops <finance@luminahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed MAP pricing & credits — Lumina (draft)

Vivek —

Thanks — the numbers look reasonable and procurement asked me to confirm two items before we move to SOW:
1) Can Lumina get the $5k onboarding credit applied as an invoice credit rather than a usage pre-burn? (Finance asks for visibility on credits in their AP flow.)
2) If we take Silver for a 3-month aggregate commit, can you put language in the SOW that the discount applies only to the committed volumes and any overage will be billed at list?

If you can confirm those two items by Monday morning PT, I can get signoff from our procurement director and route PO.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Ellen
